arms.name: Logistic regression on ESM-2 + BLOSUM62 + chemistry

sentences.S1: A model that only read protein sequences ranked harmful BRCA1 mutations better than a classic substitution table.
sentences.S3: We could not detect a benefit from adding labels from the other end of the protein.
sentences.S6: To catch 94.4% of harmful mutations, the model also flagged 437 of 899 harmless ones.

failures.guess: Guess: Position 1823 has high entropy (2.572233) and the A-to-S swap (swap_kind=other) has a positive BLOSUM62 score (1) and a positive ESM-2 score (0.746405, harm_arm2=-0.746405, band_arm2=Looks harmless), so all three arms left it unflagged (flag_arm1=0, flag_arm3=0) despite the lab LOF score (-3.642831), possibly because the DNA change disrupted RNA splicing that a protein-sequence model cannot see.

Guess: At high-entropy position 1823 (entropy=2.572233), the A-to-T swap (swap_kind=other, blosum_score=0) received a positive ESM-2 score (0.259899, harm_arm2=-0.259899, band_arm2=Looks harmless) and was missed by Arm 2 and Arm 3 (flag_arm3=0, flag_arm1=1 only at the 0.0 tie cutoff), possibly because its lab LOF score (-3.186519) reflects an untested DNA splicing effect rather than a protein-sequence penalty.

Guess: The I-to-M swap (swap_kind=other) at high-entropy position 1824 (entropy=2.362860) has a positive BLOSUM62 score (1) and a mild ESM-2 score (-0.979514, harm_arm2=0.979514, band_arm2=Looks harmless), causing all three arms to leave it unflagged (flag_arm1=0, flag_arm3=0) despite the lab LOF score (-2.078020), possibly due to a DNA splicing effect or local constraint not reflected in sequence statistics.

Guess: Although position 1670 has low entropy (0.733420), the R-to-K swap preserves charge (swap_kind=other) with a high BLOSUM62 score (2) and a mild ESM-2 score (-1.005743, harm_arm2=1.005743, band_arm2=Looks harmless), leading all three arms to leave it unflagged (flag_arm1=0, flag_arm3=0) despite the lab LOF score (-1.552698), possibly because the assay required the exact R letter or intact DNA splicing.

Guess: Position 1693 has moderate-to-high entropy (1.779203) so ESM-2 gave this A-to-D charge_change swap a mild score (-1.014801, harm_arm2=1.014801, band_arm2=Looks harmless) below Arm 2's cutoff, whereas Arm 1 and Arm 3 both flagged it (flag_arm1=1, flag_arm3=1) from its negative BLOSUM62 score (-2) and chemistry features, matching the lab LOF score (-1.539991).

Guess: The L-to-P swap (swap_kind=to_proline) carries a low BLOSUM62 score (-3) and an extreme ESM-2 penalty (esm_score=-12.934240, harm_arm2=12.934240, band_arm2=Looks harmful) that caused all three arms to flag it (flag_arm1=1, flag_arm3=1), but high-entropy position 1844 (entropy=2.041959) tolerated the swap in the lab assay (function_score=-0.232682, FUNC).

Guess: Low entropy at position 1661 (entropy=0.392916) and the E-to-V charge_change swap (blosum_score=-2) produced a large ESM-2 penalty (esm_score=-12.026711, harm_arm2=12.026711, band_arm2=Looks harmful) and flags from all three arms (flag_arm1=1, flag_arm3=1), yet the lab function score (-0.584913) remained in the FUNC range.

Guess: Near-zero entropy at position 1787 (entropy=0.044551) and the C-to-F loss_of_cysteine swap (blosum_score=-2) led to a steep ESM-2 penalty (esm_score=-11.638639, harm_arm2=11.638639, band_arm2=Looks harmful) and flags across all three arms (flag_arm1=1, flag_arm3=1), even though this swap scored as FUNC (-0.299372) in the lab assay.

Guess: Low entropy at position 1779 (entropy=0.328521) combined with a Q-to-P to_proline swap (blosum_score=-1) produced a heavy ESM-2 penalty (esm_score=-11.623756, harm_arm2=11.623756, band_arm2=Looks harmful) and flags from all three arms (flag_arm1=1, flag_arm3=1), but the variant scored as FUNC (-0.597504) in the lab assay.

Guess: Very low entropy at position 1653 (entropy=0.153824) and a negative BLOSUM62 score (-3) for the V-to-G swap (swap_kind=other) drove a steep ESM-2 penalty (esm_score=-11.412864, harm_arm2=11.412864, band_arm2=Looks harmful) and flags from all three arms (flag_arm1=1, flag_arm3=1), although the lab assay scored it as FUNC (-0.263024).
